lines.beaver: 자, 목록부터 확인할까요? 첫 번째가 뭐예요?
lines.beaver_en: Okay, shall we check the list? What's first?
lines.beaver_roman: Ja, mongnokbuteo hwaginhalkkayo? Cheot beonjjaega mwoyeyo?
lines.learner: 항아리 세 개요. 통풍이 잘되는 곳에 둬야 해요.
lines.en: Three jars. They need a well-ventilated spot.
lines.roman: Hangari se gaeyo. Tongpung-i jaldoeneun gose dwoya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then I'll put them by the window. Next?
lines.learner: 막대 다섯 개하고 망치 두 개예요.
lines.roman: Makdae daseot gaehago mangchi du gaeyeyo.

lines.beaver: 망치가 하나밖에 안 보이네요. 어디에 두셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: I only see one hammer. Where did you put it?
lines.beaver_roman: Mangchiga hanabakke an boineyo. Eodie dusyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 아, 하나는 제가 공구함에 넣어 뒀어요.
lines.en: Oh, I put one in the toolbox.
lines.roman: A, hananeun jega gongguhame neoeo dwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why are the pipes so rusty?
lines.learner: 창고 통풍이 안 좋아서 그런 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think it's because the storeroom has poor ventilation.
lines.roman: Changgo tongpung-i an joaseo geureon geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Some tin cans are dented, too.
lines.learner: 제가 깡통을 너무 높이 쌓았다는 점은 인정해요.
lines.en: I admit I stacked the cans too high.
lines.roman: Jega kkangtong-eul neomu nopi ssaatdaneun jeomeun injeonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's fine. Are the ropes and chains all here?
lines.learner: 밧줄은 두 개, 사슬은 한 개 있어요.
lines.roman: Batjureun du gae, saseureun han gae isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 사슬이 하나 더 있었는데요. 통풍구 뒤는요?
lines.beaver_en: There was one more chain. Behind the vent?
lines.beaver_roman: Saseuri hana deo isseonneundeyo. Tongpunggu dwineunyo?
lines.en: I haven't looked yet. One sec, I'll check.

lines.learner: 사슬하고 낡은 망이 있어요. 솔도 하나 있고요.
lines.en: A chain and an old net. And a brush, too.
lines.roman: Saseulhago nalgeun mang-i isseoyo. Soldo hana itgoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we dust with the brush and toss the net?
lines.learner: 네, 망은 버려요. 목록도 다 확인했어요.
lines.en: Yes, let's toss it. The list is all checked.
lines.roman: Ne, mang-eun beoryeoyo. Mongnokdo da hwaginhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good work. Next time, mind the ventilation first.
lines.en: Sure. I'll open the window often to air it out.
